acceptance.observable: The brief: docs/loops/importer-fixes-brief.md §3, rows IF-1 to IF-8, written before any candidate existed.
The planner's rulings during the build (recorded in the handoff; read them there):

"Could not tell" does not block --commit. But (a) each such input is a line in the draft report's top section, alongside STALE findings, and carries its reason; and (b) --commit prints one line naming those inputs before it proceeds. Each has a test and a mutant.
The fixture directory is listed as historical in .agents/retirements.json, on condition that it holds only importer inputs and no secret.
The IF-7 deviation at state-import.test.ts:142-143 is intended: those lines asserted the seeds themselves.
Known positive for T-180: A2A-Hub at e0bc3f8. SESSIONS/Session_14.md exists, but next-session.md is Session 13's, and INBOX was last updated at Session 11.
Set up: a worktree or git archive copy at f6b6d44, then npm ci and npm run build in open-brain.
Every IF row is re-run by you. Do not inherit the developer's results.

Check the fixture's fidelity yourself. Clone A2A-Hub read-only from GitHub into a scratch directory (gh is authenticated here). Compare each of the fixture's 7 .agents files, byte for byte, with the same path at e0bc3f8. Record any difference.
Scan the fixture for secrets with a pattern you first validate against a planted positive. Report both counts.
Probe past the brief's rows. In each case, record what the import says and whether --commit proceeds:
an input newer than the latest session;
a project with no SESSIONS/ directory;
a next-session.md that names no session;
a misspelled acknowledgement flag (T-150's rule: it must refuse).
One mutant per protection. Check that each of the developer's reverts only what it claims.

The full suite once, at f6b6d44, captured unpiped (npx vitest run > file; SUITE_EXIT=$?). Record the processes on this PC just before and after. This base carries PR #156, so the 8.3-path test should pass here.
Plain sync in a scratch clone. /sync --check after gitnexus analyze is unrun, because gitnexus is absent. Say so.
